'''Shades of Gray''' is the 8th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 15 April 2011. The set consists of 55 cards. This set is part of the ''Life from Lifelessness block'' consisting of cards from [[Life From Lifelessness]], [[Straight and Steady (expansion)|Straight and Steady]], [[BaH! (expansion)|BaH!]], [[Shades of Gray (expansion)|Shades of Gray]], and [[Resistance Is Futile]] virtual expansions.

==Trivia==
*The word '''gray''' is misspelled in this expansion's name. It should've been '''grey'''.
*However, the title is directly taken from the Star Trek: The Next Generation episode "[http://en.memory-alpha.org/wiki/Shades_of_Gray_%28episode%29 Shades of Gray]".
